title: Acquisition by Sumitomo Corporation, SBI Ventures Asset Pte Ltd, Blue Haven Global Limited, LR Africa Holdings SPC, Broadscale MK Investors LP, Stelvio LLC, Solar X Co-Invest LP and Development Finance Institute Canada Inc of Indirect Control of M-Kopa Tanzania Limited
title_sw: Acquisition by Sumitomo Corporation, SBI Ventures Asset Pte Ltd, Blue Haven Global Limited, LR Africa Holdings SPC, Broadscale MK Investors LP, Stelvio LLC, Solar X Co-Invest LP and Development Finance Institute Canada Inc of Indirect Control of M-Kopa Tanzania Limited
text: Sumitomo Corporation, SBI Ventures Asset Pte Ltd, Blue Haven Global Limited, LR Africa Holdings SPC, Broadscale MK Investors LP, Stelvio LLC, Solar X Co-Invest LP And Development Finance Institute Canada (DFIC) Inc., notified the Fair Competition Commission (FCC) of their intentions to acquire 37.26 percent shares in M-KOPA Holdings Limited and hence gain indirect control of M-KOPA Tanzania Limited. Based on the analysis, the transaction has no possibility of either creating or strengthening a position of dominance in the relevant market therefore, transaction was approved without conditions.
